functions.name: GOVERN
functions.description: Establish and monitor the organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy.

functions.name: IDENTIFY
functions.description: Determine the current cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, individuals, and third parties.

functions.name: PROTECT
functions.description: Use safeguards to prevent or reduce cybersecurity risks to assets and data.

functions.name: DETECT
functions.description: Find and analyze possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises.

functions.name: RESPOND
functions.description: Take action regarding a detected cybersecurity incident.

functions.name: RECOVER
functions.description: Restore assets and operations that were impacted by a cybersecurity incident.
